subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Why the Last Mile Is Hardest
description: A quick win: understand Why the Last Mile Is Hardest.

hook.text: A package travels 3,000 miles in two days. The final five miles to your door take another two days.

buildup.text: The last mile is the final leg of delivery—from a local hub to the customer's doorstep.

discovery.text: It accounts for 53% of total shipping cost because each stop serves one address with one small delivery.

twist.text: The first 3,000 miles move thousands of packages together. The last five move one at a time.

climax.text: E-commerce has exploded last-mile volume. The cost and complexity keep growing with every new expectation.

punchline.text: The last mile is the most expensive mile in logistics.

quiz.question: What share of total shipping cost does the last mile represent?
